svg.title: Rotational inertias of ten common objects
svg.desc: Ten objects with their rotation axes and moments of inertia: hoop about its cylinder axis, annular cylinder about its cylinder axis, solid cylinder about its cylinder axis and about a central diameter, thin rod about its center and one end, solid sphere and thin spherical shell about a diameter, hoop about a diameter, and rectangular slab about a perpendicular central axis. M is total mass, R is radius, ℓ is length, and a and b are slab side lengths. Green dashed lines indicate rotation axes.
